newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * The National Peasant Party (PNTCD) and the Social Democratic Union (USD) met at PNTCD headquarters to continue talks on the composition of the government.
USD leader Petre Roman is attending the talks which are expected to settle appointments for the communications, defence and health portfolios.

* With government negotiations under way, PNTCD leader Ion Diaconescu and Prime Minister designate Victor Ciorbea gave few details on government appointments, but they confirmed that the cabinet make-up and its programme were priorities for the ruling coalition this week.
Ciorbea said the draft government programme would be presented to a team of International Monetary Fund experts due to arrive in Romania on Friday.
* President Ion Iliescu called a news conference on Tuesday at the end of his term in office.
* A delegation from the Croatian Constitutional Court arrived for a two-day visit to Romania. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
